title: agrostis domingensis
intro: Agrostis domingensis, commonly known as Puerto Rican bentgrass, is a species of grass native to the Caribbean. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Agrostis domingensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, kill bacteria, and promote wound healing, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its potential health benefits.
